Questions & answers.

A clear introduction to me and my work.

Who is To’rabek Raufov?

To’rabek Raufov is an entrepreneur, full-stack developer, project manager, and design enthusiast. He works on digital products and has a particular interest in travel tech.

What projects has To’rabek worked on?

His portfolio includes Tourfixer, AdvoAI, and GoPrava. Tourfixer is a travel-tech platform, AdvoAI is a legal-AI product he co-founded with khudoykulov.uz, and GoPrava is an ongoing project.

What is Tourfixer?

Tourfixer brings together private transfers, local guides, and day trips across Uzbekistan. It is one of the projects in To’rabek’s portfolio and connects with his interest in travel technology.

Who co-founded AdvoAI?

To’rabek Raufov co-founded AdvoAI with khudoykulov.uz. Its public interface includes legal questions and tools for working with contracts.

Is GoPrava available?

GoPrava is in progress. A public product link and screenshots have not been shared yet. Contact To’rabek on Telegram to ask about the project.

How can I contact To’rabek Raufov?

The preferred public contact is Telegram at t.me/t6rabek. You can also find him on GitHub and LinkedIn using the handle t6rabek.
